title: Studio Google and Native Login Interactions

origin.summary: Implement Google-first Studio authentication, document the future native alternative, and keep native-password verification safe during local validation.

events.note: Created for the requested Google-first Studio login and right-aligned profile menu implementation.
Implementation begins immediately; raw passwords and tokens must not be logged.
Implemented Studio Google token handoff, right-aligned profile menu, and development-only native submission validation with redacted audit logging.
Added runtime discovery of the public Google client ID from configured server OIDC metadata and blocked native-password validation over non-loopback HTTP.
